d:
Jamshedpur ke gopal maidan men marpit ki ghatna ke bad jharkhand aandolan ke neta sury sinh besra ek bar phir charcha men hain. aakhir kaun hain sury sinh besra? jharkhand aandolan men unki kya bhumika rahi hai aur unka rajnitik saphar kaisa raha hai? janie is khas riport men.
